user_goal.primary: R1/R2/R3 qualified selections >= 75% hit rate on strict chronological forward out-of-sample predictions
user_goal.secondary: Full-matchday hit rate, evaluated separately; no quota on ODD vs EVEN

frozen_baseline.interpretation: A single round is insufficient to establish a >75% long-run rate. No hindsight changes.

model_trials.method: Do not modify archived pre-match direction, ranks or model line. Strictly compare same temporal fixtures.
Using ONLY pre-match features, estimate calibrated scoreline probabilities P(H=i,A=j) with appropriate low-score/draw dependence. P(EVEN)=sum of probabilities where i+j is even; P(ODD)=1-P(EVEN).
model_trials.guard: A plain independent-Poisson total-score model is intrinsically weak for parity, as P(EVEN)>=0.5. Require explicit out-of-sample calibration rather than treating draw as automatic EVEN certainty.
model_trials.training: Chronological previous seasons only; never fit using evaluation fixtures

model_trials.method: Compare Official versus already independently sealed R90 Recovery Shadow direction and calibrated probability, select at most 3 qualifying picks based on training-only gate thresholds
model_trials.guard: Agreement is not proof of reliability; evaluate it separately against no-gate baseline. Shadow remains separate unless promotion passes validation.

model_trials.method: Derive BOTH directions and qualified R1/R2/R3 from same pre-specified scoreline and selector logic; freeze test implementation and parameter hashes before forward evaluation
model_trials.guard: Changing only R order does not satisfy objective if direction reliability does not improve.

rank_and_pass_policy.R1_R2_R3_order: Deterministic descending calibrated confidence, fixed stable tie-breaker
rank_and_pass_policy.official_qualification: A qualified pick must pass frozen min-confidence and quality gates. Unqualified candidates remain display-only, classed PASS/RESEARCH_NOT_QUALIFIED, and excluded from Official accuracy.
rank_and_pass_policy.insufficient_qualifiers: Do not invent betting-eligible R ranks; record which R1-R3 candidates failed gates.

validation.data_requirements: Seek verified 6+ seasons of fixtures, final scores and time-valid inputs; declare MISSING when unavailable.
validation.split: Chronological expanding-window or rolling-window walk-forward. Hyperparameter selection uses earlier training/validation blocks only, not the sealed test block.
validation.no_leakage: Strictly prohibit using the target result, post-kickoff odds, future matches in rolling form, or full-season normalization calculated from future games.
validation.row_unit: One match, one pre-kickoff immutable record, one final settlement. PASS not counted.
report: PASS and qualified coverage per round
validation.candidate_success: Target >=75% across pooled qualified R1-R3 and inspect each R1/R2/R3 individually with adequate samples, under proper strict forward validation; cannot infer from latest one round.
validation.minimum_observation_goal: At least 20 independent matchweeks and 60 qualified predictions for pooled R1-R3 where coverage permits; report per-rank sample count and Wilson 95% intervals; do not promote from a single round.
validation.promotion_gate: Only TEST or WATCH until an out-of-sample candidate clears predeclared accuracy, coverage, confidence and reproducibility tests; manual approval before official promotion.

execution_status.reason: User has chosen research objective; data/feature completeness and strict forward testing have yet to be verified.
